_readme: Top-of-site banner slot. Set `active` to sell the spot; leave it null and the site rotates your own `house` promos so the slot is never empty. Edit, commit, push — live in about a minute.

_fields.sponsor: advertiser name, shown under the headline
_fields.headline: one short line, roughly 60 characters
_fields.image: optional square logo/art URL (https), falls back to the emoji
_fields.emoji: optional, used when there is no image
_fields.until: YYYY-MM-DD — the slot auto-reverts to house promos after this date, so a finished campaign never runs on past its booking

house.headline: Stake your Rangers — 100 Fox Points a day, each
